contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [DN] CONSTANTI N[---] ; R/ BEATA TRAN QVILLITAS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321-323, Lyon mint, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped, cuirassed probably left. Obverse inscription: [DN] CONSTANTI N[---]. Reverse description: Globe on altar. Reverse inscription: BEATA TRAN QVILLITAS. In exergue: PLG. Diameter: 18.7mm, Weight: 2.44gms, die axis: 6
